benefits.text:
(As Per GR Dated 1.3.2011 Medical education Dept. & 11.09.2003)
AMS Junior level:-Scholarship amount sanction as per Government Rule varies from course to course 11th - 12th - Rs.1600/- to Rs. 2300/-
AMS Senior level:- Scholarship amount sanction as per Government Rule varies from course to course from Rs.2800 to 72000/- plus.
